purpose: The fifth member of the Feature-List family and the only one still unconfirmed live: the endpoint that lets REST add a custom feature at all, which operations.instantiate_feature has always targeted. Confirms the BTFeatureDefinitionCall-1406 envelope, the spiralRidge feature type, and that an added feature comes back with a new featureId and an OK state.
testPurpose: Replay: the recorded body must parse through feature_list.summarize_feature_definition and report featureStatus OK with the featureType and namespace the request named, so an add that silently resolves to a different definition would show up as data.
namespaceNote: The namespace microversion is not invented: e28387ea6f126e7d45ef539ac::md300f71d986982a9df2b8733 is what the live Feature List read returned for this feature type earlier in the same session.
parametersNote: parameters is empty because the spiralRidge spec declares none -- the generated FeatureScript bakes the geometry values in as literals. That is also why the P3 in-place replace could round-trip an empty parameter array.
responseHeaders: Not persisted: the shared OnshapeClient returns the parsed body only.
